result:
I'm returning **PASS** for DG2 round 10. I raised no new findings and had no open ones to verify, so I wrote no findings or verifications file.

**Candidate.** I recomputed `sha256:7fd1a89ca090dbdea5ae9f014853684239cbf80e89dc5cce50914155cb9d484a` (544 files) in the repository and in a disposable clone, and both match. Since `fe22d759` (the commit under review), only delivery records have changed. During my run the orchestrator committed `6dd71477`, which changes two timestamps in `stages.json`. The candidate ID did not change. DG1 still passes historical validation.

**Checks**, all run on both Node 22.22.2 and Node 24.21.0:
- **Static checks:** `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint` and the contrast check all exit 0. `pnpm test` passes 765 of 765.
- **Live walk-through** (disposable PostgreSQL, synthetic data): Diagnose→Define→Design passes 101/101 and the design registers pass 11/11. G1, G2 and G3 advance in order under their B0023 names, and submitting out of order is refused.
- **This round's API change (D-070):** a new probe passes 17/17.
  - An unknown address answers "not found" whatever the request format.
  - A refused upload names `application/octet-stream`, and a refused JSON request names `application/json`. The refusal message is localized in EN and AR, and nothing is stored.
  - A space or tab before `;` in the format header is still accepted.
  - JSON declared in a non-UTF-8 character set is refused.
  - Two format headers on one request are refused.
- **Arabic text and evidence upload:**
  - Arabic text with emoji and RLM marks is stored verbatim through both the API and the UI.
  - An invisible-only value is refused with the localized message in EN (left-to-right) and AR (right-to-left).
  - A file uploaded through the API or the Evidence page downloads byte-identical, keeps its Arabic file name and shows as Unverified.
- **Regressions:** my probes from the four previous repairs (D-066 to D-069) all still pass.
- **Invariants:** this round's change touches only seven files in the API's platform layer, with no text, UI, data or rule changes.
  - The B0009 mode guidance and B0023 gate names are verbatim.
  - PMI and "official" appear only in the disclaimers.
  - `#0078FF` is marked provisional.
  - Migrations contain no floating-point columns.
  - The product's gates are only G1–G6; DG0–DG7 appears only in comments and notes.
- **Environmental items** (live registry D-057, live CI D-058, Keycloak D-049): checked only on their offline or configuration surface and recorded as PASS there, as the assignment directs.

**Findings:** none, so nothing at any severity.

The write guard refused the assigned handback path (`docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/…`) for my role. The assignment and the write scopes contradict each other here; I put the handback in my evidence folder instead, as in round 9.

The reused round-9 probes still label their test data "Synthetic R9", so that name appears in some screenshots. I deleted the disposable clone and scratch data afterwards.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG2/round-10/domain-reviewer.json` (validated against the review schema; every evidence path exists)
- `reviews/DG2/round-10/domain-reviewer.md`
- `test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-10/handback-T-DG2-REV-DOM-R10-domain-reviewer.md`
